This mod changes craftable fences ( wood, stone, iron & hardwood )
Each seasonal retexture can be disabled in config ( vines/moss/petals can be disabled too )
On the Island all fences have always summer texture on ( no snow in tropics c: )

Available also as an Alternative Textures pack here -> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19191]Cottagecore Fences for AT[/url]﻿
